purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19002 (FBS-220) driving rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> through bin/rcf.js, so the FBS-220 Define round turns each declaration into a red test against the report-ingesting Finalise.
title: Administrative Finalise: rcf build finalise --ci-run ingests the Test-stage report and promotes to verified, refuses missing, uncontained, stale, non-separate or blocking reports, retires --mode and --url, spawns nothing

testCases.description: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> with a valid verifier PASS report exits 0, sets executionStatus verified and prints "finalise: <fbs-id> verified from <report path> (head <sha7>, ci <ref>)", spawning nothing but git
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20001-1: over DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: MERGE/PASS at H touching both criteria and TEST: PASS with a passing test-strength record at H, and no rcf/verify-reports/, finalise FBS-001 --ci-run run-7 exits 0 with the complete line, writes executionStatus complete and changes nothing else in the tree

testCases.description: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> with no report exits 4 with "finalise refused: no Test-stage verify report for <fbs-id>; the verifier runs rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier before merge" and the FBS stays complete
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20001-2: with no REVIEW: commit finalise exits 4 "finalise refused: no REVIEW verdict for FBS-001 on the branch", and with a ReviewVerdict MERGE/FINDINGS it exits 4 "finalise refused: REVIEW at <H7> is MERGE/FINDINGS; a failed verdict closes the round"

testCases.description: rcf build finalise exits 4 with "finalise refused: report head <sha7> is not contained in HEAD <sha7>; re-verify this head" or "report is <n> days old" (the loopback clause moved to AC-19005-2 to -4, ADR-4151)
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20001-4: a BUILD: late fix or a DEFINE: amend after the TEST: commit refuses with exit 4 "finalise refused: REVIEW reopened by <s7> <STAGE>: after the reviewed head <H7>", while a FINALISE: lockfile commit and a clean FINALISE: merge of main (with a green --merge-suite at the merge head) do not refuse

testCases.description: rcf build finalise on a report whose hand is not verifier or whose verifierId matches a builder Hand-Id exits 4 with "finalise refused: report hand <hand>/<id> is not separate from the builder" and the FBS is unchanged
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20002-4: an earlier BUILD: tests commit touching test/rcf/a.test.js makes finalise exit 4 "finalise refused: separation FAIL: <s7> BUILD: touches test/rcf/a.test.js (class rcfTest, owned by DEFINE)", and a Hand: mixed commit refuses the same way with the retired-mixed item

testCases.description: rcf build finalise exits 4 "ci evidence missing: pass --ci-run <ref>", 4 not-complete and 3 "missing Code Nodes: <ac-ids>"; a report failing VerifyReport v1 exits 3 naming the field (the off-trunk clause moved to AC-19005-1, ADR-4151)
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20002-3: with no --ci-run finalise exits 4 "ci evidence missing: pass --ci-run <ref>", with AC-101-2 lacking a Code Node it exits 3 "finalise refused: missing Code Node for AC-101-2", and an untouched criterion of the spec with no Code Node does not refuse

testCases.description: rcf build finalise on a report carrying MOCK-ONLY-DECLARED, EVAL-MISSING, EVAL-BELOW-THRESHOLD, UI-BASELINE-UNMET, BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING or SCOPE-MISMATCH, or a non-PASS or non-ship verdict, exits 4 with the 0.20.0 and 0.28.0 message shapes
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20001-3: with the TEST: commit absent finalise exits 4 "no TEST verdict at <H7>", with a TestVerdict FAIL at H "TEST at <H7> is FAIL", and with a TEST PASS at H then a FAIL TestVerdict at the later head M "TEST at <M7> is FAIL; a failed verdict closes the round"

testCases.description: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --mode <any> or --url <url> exits 2 with "finalise no longer runs verify; run rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier at the Test stage" and spawns nothing
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20003-1: each retired flag (--report, --max-report-age 7, --mode deterministic, --url http://localhost:8787, --allow-pre-merge) makes finalise exit 2 with the no-verify-report line, spawn nothing and write nothing

testCases.description: rcf build finalise never spawns rcf verify run, the verifier package or the agent CLI, and every refusal leaves rcf/fbs/<fbs-id>.json byte-identical
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/administrative-finalise.test.js::AC-19002-8: rcf build finalise never spawns rcf verify run, the verifier package or the agent CLI, and every refusal leaves rcf/fbs/<fbs-id>.json byte-identical

testCases.description: End to end: a real rcf verify run --hand verifier --fbs FBS-001 --url <non-loopback preview> --mode deterministic --profile ci passes, writes rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/<head12>.json with verdict PASS and verdictAuthority ship; after a --no-ff merge and the complete mark, rcf build finalise FBS-001 --ci-run <ref> exits 0, prints the verified-from line and spawns nothing but git.

testCases.description: End to end: a real verify run on a nonDeterministic AC with no EVAL records EVAL-MISSING on that AC in the report perAc row; rcf build finalise refuses exit 4 with the 0.20.0 EVAL-missing message, the FBS stays complete and byte-identical, nothing but git is spawned.

testCases.description: A real report on the feature head, squash-merged to main: the report head is not an ancestor of HEAD and the squash tree differs from it only under rcf/verify-reports/, so it is tree-equal and rcf build finalise promotes (exit 0, verified).
